description: A young woman in a pink and mint traditional Korean dress spins in front of a tiled palace gate in daylight. She then sits at a night street-food market strung with paper lanterns, eating an orange rice cake from a paper cup and pulling a wide-eyed face at the taste. The last shot is a night city crossing where whole building fronts are covered in glowing electric signs in red, blue and yellow; a bus passes behind her while she makes a small finger heart.
